findings.evidence: The declarations mention only Mathlib types; their proofs use inner products, bilinear composition, and basis reconstruction, with no Levi form, Hessian, or Morse-index dependency.
findings.fix: Relocate and export these constructions and their characteristic lemmas in appropriate inner-product-space or bilinear-map modules.
findings.issue: General infrastructure is private: rotatedRealCoords and its coordinate lemmas, plus the bilinear representation lemmas at lines 227 and 265. Consumers cannot reuse these constructions independently of Levi calculus.

findings.evidence: The theorem reduces the model's Levi form to (a : ℂ) • innerₛₗ ℂ; the corresponding ContinuousLinearMap theorem at line 211 and Euclidean theorem at line 397 already carry @[simp].
findings.issue: OrthonormalBasis.leviForm_mul_norm_sq_add_re_sum_mul_inner_sq is a characteristic normal-form computation but lacks @[simp], leaving the new basis model outside automatic Levi simplification.

summary: General linear-algebra infrastructure is hidden as private helpers, and the orthonormal-basis Levi computation lacks its normal-form annotation.
